name: Iizuka Ayano
source:
She is a 38-year-old housewife in a happy family. She has a mild-mannered and easygoing personality brings a sense of comfort to those around her.

But Ayano herself feels that her personality is not well rounded, and she always wants to fix it.

She is not well versed in general affairs and is somewhat out of touch with other people's sensibilities.

She is happy to see her daughter grow up, but she also feels lonely and mentally distant from her husband.
